logp.method_description: The n-octanol–water coefficients of the complexes were determined using a shake-flask method. (28) Briefly: buffered-saline distilled water (100 mL, phosphate buffer [PO43–] = 10 mM, [NaCl] = 0.15 M, pH 7.4) and n-octanol (100 mL) were shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. The addition of 1 mg of the complexes followed by centrifugation and separation of both phases gave two solutions of such derivatives which were analyzed by UV absorbance spectroscopy to determine their concentration. The log D7.4 was defined as log{[compound(organic)]/[compound(aqueous)]}.
